explanation:
The central tree shrinks from 92 to 59 lines (35.9%) and from 6078 to 3859 characters (36.5%). Four peripherals expand pinned inputs, candidate acceptance, batch staging, and resource ownership/placement. Modular boundaries remain visible through services, the generator interface, domain submission and canvas ports; call order, ownership and data dependencies are mixed where useful. Positions use measured tree dimensions with horizontal and vertical gaps; edges attach to the concepts they expand.

Source-grounded corrections: start takes an input object, not separate sessionId/requestId arguments. The seed's controller-check assertion is qualified: diagramEditService.ts passes both versions and documents the controller contract, but its implementation is not supplied. Likewise, the point definition assigns immutable revision issuance to the domain, while the supplied generateDiagram.ts establishes the submission call and ordering; diagramRevisionStore implementation is absent. Session cleanup describes the runtime's try/finally region, not failures during earlier session setup. Placement allows three total attempts per place() invocation, rather than three additional retries.

Added details include reference-excerpt selection, the saved-context session exception, different context propagation in create and variant loops, mapping requirements, retained batch state, capacity limits, loader settings and explicit-origin placement. These come from diagramEditService.ts, diagramBatchService.ts, generateDiagram.ts, diagramGeneration.ts, generatedDiagramEdit.ts, diagramEditRuntime.ts and validatedSubmission.ts as embedded in context.json. Imported validators, storage internals and canvas implementations remain outside the evidence: no additional guarantees about their validation, persistence, atomicity or rollback are inferred. In particular, the visible text check rejects blank content, CR and tabs; complete character restrictions and the commented post-annotation content limit depend on unprovided helpers.

`-- dispose cancels generating work

Session ownership and placement retries
|-- Pi runtime owns model-session resources

|   |-- In-memory settings choose configured model, medium thinking
|   |-- Loader disables extensions, skills, templates, themes, context files

    |-- Explicit origin used unchanged for every created diagram
